_comment: Manually-maintained Australian Competition Tribunal appeal data, keyed by ACCC merger_id. Merged into the frontend data by scripts/static_data (see loaders.load_tribunal_appeals and enrichment.link_tribunal_appeals). A merger appears 'under appeal' whenever it has an entry here. Fields: tribunal_number (e.g. 'ACT 1 of 2026'), tribunal_url (the tribunal current-matters page), appeal_type (one of party_denial / party_conditional_clearance / third_party_clearance — see scripts/constants/tribunal.py), appellant (who lodged the review), filed_date (ISO date the application was lodged), and documents[] which are folded into the merger's event timeline. Each document: date, filed_by, description, confidentiality ('Confidential' | 'Non-confidential'), url (direct tribunal link, treated like an ACCC url), and optionally url_gh (local mirror served from data/raw/matters/{id}/). Tribunal scraping will maintain this file automatically in future; for now it is edited by hand.
